dulse.why: No USDA FoodData Central record in SR Legacy, Foundation or FNDDS.
dulse.standardNutrientInfo: No. Only generic 'Seaweed, dried' (FNDDS 2709988), which is not dulse.
dulse.alternativeFormat: Short seaweed note (iodine, sourced from NIH ODS) instead of a nutrient profile.
dulse.recommendation: Leave unprofiled until a verified composition source is chosen.

surveyRecord.limitation: No SR Legacy, Foundation or FNDDS record for dulse. Generic FNDDS "Seaweed, dried" (2709988) is not dulse and must not stand in for it.

hijiki.why: No USDA record. Hijiki has a known inorganic-arsenic concern raised by food-safety agencies; no such source was read for this project.
hijiki.alternativeFormat: Safety-first note only, once an agency source is read and quoted.
hijiki.keepInCatalogue: Owner decision. Recommend removing it, or keeping it unprofiled and not ship-ready.
hijiki.recommendation: Do not profile. Needs an agency source before any wording.

surveyRecord.limitation: No record. Nothing should stand in for it; the open issue is safety, not composition.

kombu.why: No USDA record for dried kombu. Raw kelp (168457) is drafted as 'kelp' but is a different preparation.
kombu.standardNutrientInfo: Partly. Generic 'Seaweed, dried' (FNDDS 2709988) exists but is not kombu. NIH ODS names kombu among the best food sources of iodine.
kombu.alternativeFormat: Seaweed note led by the sourced iodine fact (NIH ODS: upper limit 1,100 µg/day), or merge into the kelp profile.
kombu.recommendation: Owner decision: iodine-led note, or merge with kelp.

surveyRecord.limitation: Only generic FNDDS "Seaweed, dried" (2709988) and raw kelp (SR 168457, already used for kelp). Neither is dried kombu; iodine differs widely between seaweeds.

guacamole.why: No SR Legacy or Foundation record. Earlier note said no USDA record; FNDDS does have one.
guacamole.standardNutrientInfo: Yes, as an average recipe: FNDDS 2709307 'Guacamole, NFS' and 2709308 'Guacamole with tomatoes'.
guacamole.alternativeFormat: A dish-style profile stating it is an average recipe and that salt and ingredients vary.
guacamole.recommendation: Draftable from FNDDS once you accept survey (average-recipe) data.

surveyRecord.limitation: FNDDS 2709307 "Guacamole, NFS" (updated 10/31/2024) is a survey average of recipes eaten in the US, not a defined recipe. If used, the profile must say "average guacamole" and that avocado share, salt and added ingredients vary.

black-soybean.why: No USDA record for black soybeans; the yellow soybean record is a different variety.
black-soybean.keepInCatalogue: Owner decision. Already not ship-ready; recommend leaving it unprofiled or removing it.
black-soybean.recommendation: Hold until a label or lab source is chosen.

surveyRecord.limitation: No black soybean record. The yellow soybean record is a different variety and must not stand in.

seitan.why: Composition depends on the product (vital wheat gluten, soy sauce, salt).
seitan.standardNutrientInfo: Only generic: vital wheat gluten ingredient (SR 168147) and a generic 'meat substitute, cereal- and vegetable protein-based' (FNDDS 2709163). Neither is seitan as eaten.
seitan.alternativeFormat: Label-based profile for a named product, or a note that values vary.

surveyRecord.limitation: The only FNDDS candidate (2709163, "Meat substitute, cereal- and vegetable protein-based, fried") is a generic fried product, not seitan; vital wheat gluten (SR 168147) is an ingredient. Neither represents seitan as eaten.

oat-milk.why: Earlier note said no SR Legacy record. A USDA Foundation record does exist.
oat-milk.standardNutrientInfo: Yes: Foundation 2257046 'Oat milk, unsweetened, plain, refrigerated' and FNDDS 2705412 'Oat milk'.
oat-milk.alternativeFormat: Standard profile, stating it is unsweetened plain oat milk and that fortification varies by brand.
oat-milk.recommendation: Draftable now from Foundation 2257046. Not drafted in this audit (scope).

surveyRecord.limitation: USDA Foundation 2257046 "Oat milk, unsweetened, plain, refrigerated" (4/28/2022) is a defined product type and the best fit. Limitation: one plain unsweetened product; fortification, oil and sugar vary by brand, and the record lists no household measure, so a cup weight must be sourced when drafting.

muesli.why: No generic USDA record; only brand cereals (SR 169075 Alpen, 169076 Familia).
muesli.alternativeFormat: Label-based profile for a named product.

surveyRecord.limitation: Only brand cereals (SR 169075 Alpen, 169076 Familia). Using one would present a brand as muesli in general.

salt.why: Salt is not a nutrient-offering food. A profile would be a sodium limit message.
salt.standardNutrientInfo: Yes for sodium, but there is nothing to 'offer'. The sourced limit is verified: FDA/Dietary Guidelines advise adults to keep sodium under 2,300 mg a day.
salt.alternativeFormat: A 'Salt and sodium' information card (not a Food Detail profile). The sodium cautions now added to salty foods already carry the limit.
salt.keepInCatalogue: Owner decision. Recommend an information card or removing it from the food list.
salt.recommendation: Do not profile as a food.

surveyRecord.limitation: Composition exists but a nutrient profile is the wrong format.

alcohol.why: Not a nutrient-offering food; any text is a health-risk message needing expert wording.
alcohol.standardNutrientInfo: Yes (SR/FNDDS list beer, wine, spirits) but nutrient content is not the point.
alcohol.alternativeFormat: Safety information card with sourced guidance (Dietary Guidelines, NIAAA, pregnancy advice), none of which was read here.
alcohol.keepInCatalogue: Owner decision. Recommend an information card or removing it from the food list.
alcohol.recommendation: Do not profile as a food.

surveyRecord.limitation: FNDDS/SR list beers, wines and spirits separately; "moderate alcohol" is a drinking pattern, not a food record.

bancha-tea.why: Brewed tea has almost no nutrients; caffeine, fluoride and tannin wording needs sources.
bancha-tea.standardNutrientInfo: Partly: SR 171917 'tea, green, brewed' exists, not bancha specifically; values are close to zero.
bancha-tea.alternativeFormat: Short drink note (caffeine) with a sourced FDA statement.
bancha-tea.recommendation: Owner decision on format; low priority.

surveyRecord.limitation: SR 171917 "Beverages, tea, green, brewed, regular" (4/1/2019) is generic green tea. Bancha is a specific Japanese green tea; values are near zero either way, so the limitation is identity, not numbers.

coffee.why: Brewed coffee has almost no nutrients; caffeine guidance needs sourced wording.
coffee.alternativeFormat: Short drink note with sourced caffeine guidance.
coffee.recommendation: Owner decision on format; low priority.

surveyRecord.limitation: FNDDS 2710375 "Coffee, brewed" (10/31/2024) is appropriate for the (negligible) nutrient data. Limitation: caffeine is not in the nutrient set tracked here, and it is the point of the entry.

decaf-coffee.why: As coffee; residual caffeine wording needs a source.
decaf-coffee.alternativeFormat: Combine with the coffee drink note.

surveyRecord.limitation: FNDDS 2710452 "Coffee, brewed, decaffeinated" (10/31/2024), same limitation as coffee.

soft-shell-crab.why: Soft-shell crab is blue crab eaten whole, usually fried; the cooked blue crab record is a different preparation.
soft-shell-crab.standardNutrientInfo: Yes, as a prepared food: FNDDS 2706346 'Crab, soft shell'. Cooked blue crab: SR 174205.
soft-shell-crab.alternativeFormat: Standard profile from FNDDS with the preparation stated, or merge into the crab profile.
soft-shell-crab.recommendation: Owner decision: draft from FNDDS or merge with crab.

surveyRecord.limitation: FNDDS 2706346 "Crab, soft shell" (10/31/2024, about 227 kcal per 100 g) is a prepared survey average, probably fried. If used, the profile must state that it is the prepared dish, not the animal; cooked blue crab (SR 174205) is a different preparation.

fresh-water-clam.why: USDA has only marine and mixed clam records; freshwater clam composition differs.
fresh-water-clam.keepInCatalogue: Owner decision. Already not ship-ready; recommend removing it.

surveyRecord.limitation: No freshwater clam record; marine clam records must not stand in.
